name: Soul of the Bard
body:
Associated Skills: Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, Perform

Associated Veils: Bangles of the Jealous Seductress, Courtesan’s Cloak, Coward’s Boots, Hands of the Bard, H’s Flowered Regalia, Iron Crown, Nymph’s Visage, Priestess’ Clasp of Rebirth

Bardic Inspiration (Su)

At 1st level, you tap into the inspiring chorus of the bard’s soul, allowing you to project an aura of inspiration in a 30 foot radius. Activating or deactivating this aura is a standard action. You can use this aura for a total number of rounds per day equal to 4 + your Wisdom, plus an additional 2 rounds per soulforge level after 1st. Temporary increases to your Wisdom do not increase the number of rounds you can use this aura each day.

Allies in this aura, including you, are inspired by the songs of the bard’s soul, granting them a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against charm and fear effects and a +1 competence bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls. At 5th level, and every six soulforge levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1, to a maximum of +4 at 17th level. This ability is a mind-affecting ability.

At 7th level, you may activate or deactivate this aura as a move action instead of a standard action. At 13th level, you may activate it or deactivate it as a swift action as well.

This ability does not count as the inspire courage ability for the purposes of feats or abilities.

Lore Master (Ex)

At 3rd level, your forging of the bard soul imbues your mind with the lore and stories of ancient bards.

You can take 10 on any Knowledge check you have ranks in even while under duress.

In addition, once per day you can take 20 on any Knowledge skill check you have ranks in as a standard action, even while under duress. You can use this ability an additional time at 9th level, and again at 15th level.

Jack of all Trades

At 5th level, you tap into the bard’s ability to perform any skill, even those you don’t have training in. You can attempt any skill check untrained, and gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your class level on untrained skill checks (rounded up).
